lines.en: Flying low over the sand, the wind is hot.
My wings beat like a drum.
I circle a sand dune.

lines.zh: 贴着你的头顶低飞而过。
lines.en: I skim low over your head.
I drop low and bank aside.
I halt in the air and shake my wings.
The wind lifts the sand.
I fly fast through the heat haze.
I take a wide loop.
I head for some shade.
I fly along the dune's edge.
First I circle, then I dive.
My legs are tucked under me.
I cross cracked red earth.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一扇，从沙面上抬起来。
lines.en: One wingbeat lifts me off the sand.
I fly toward that figure.
I hover with my wings still beating.
Sand grains strike my shell.
I'm watching what moves below.
The sun is fierce; I don't care.
My compound eyes fix on the sand.
My wings buzz.
I wait for it to look up.
The heat shimmer wavers here.
My shadow circles on the sand.
Hanging in the hot wind is enough for me.
I'd like somewhere to land.
I rise a little higher.
You're standing below me.
I see the top of your head.

lines.zh: 我绕你一圈，沙尘跟着转。
lines.en: I circle you, dust circling with me.
You can look up, and can't reach me.
Your shadow is easy to spot.

lines.zh: 我压低翅膀，悬在你头顶。
lines.en: I lower my wings, hovering over your head.
The sand will get in your eyes.
I'm holding here.
If you run, I follow.

lines.zh: 你每踩一步，沙子就动一下。
lines.en: Every step you take stirs the sand.
My wingbeat stuttered.
I veer away.
There's a new dent in my shell.
I climb higher.
I didn't fall.
I wheel half a turn.
I steadied myself.
A hole is torn in my wing membrane.
My wing is a little stiff.
I can still fly on one wing.

lines.zh: 地上这些东西，我从不碰。
lines.en: I never touch what lies on the ground.
Are you holding that up?
I circle once and don't come down.
It glints in the sun.
I touch down once, then rise.
What's in the sand suits me better.
Not worth the trip.
I fly just over it.
I open my claws to test.
Never mind; not worth going down.
You hit my wing.

lines.zh: 翅膀一歪，我打着旋儿稳住。
lines.en: A wing tips; I spin and right myself.
I hit you and bounced off.
Between us we've kicked up sand.
My wingbeat has gone rough.
I've climbed again.
I dive; you stagger back into the sand.
I settle on the stone beside.

lines.zh: 沙粒跟着我们飞了一阵。
lines.en: Sand flew with us a moment.
I skim low, then slam into you.

lines.zh: 另一只从沙丘后升起来。
lines.en: Another rises from behind the dune.
We circle the same loop.
Its wings are bigger than mine.
We pass wing to wing.
Two shadows move on the sand.
We fly the same way.
Afterward we part.
This hot wind serves us both.
We don't land.
I hear its wingbeat.
I dive and snatch it.
I hook it with my claws.
Too heavy; I can't climb.
Sand whirls beneath my wings.

lines.zh: 我把猎物丢下去，再抓一次。
lines.en: I drop the catch and snatch it again.
That barely counts.
I circle once with it.
The sand buried half of it.

lines.zh: 沙漠上空，我低低绕一圈。
lines.en: Above the desert I circle low once.

lines.zh: 我松开爪子，沙粒从螯里落下。
lines.en: I open my claws; sand falls from them.
Something crawls beneath the dune.
My compound eyes lock on first.

lines.zh: 沙面上那个影子，归我了。
lines.en: That shadow on the sand is mine.
I start to circle.
It's still walking, never stopping.
Wings folded, I dive.
This dive goes for its back.
I've drawn my legs in.
I fold my wings and drop.
The sand churns beneath me.
It sees me up here.
Now — it's right beneath me.
I fly in low.
I skim the sand.
Sand grains hit my face.
It goes left, and I bank left.
A tilt of my wings, and I'm behind it.
The wind helps me throw sand.
It can't raise its head.
A little lower.
My shadow lands on the sand before I do.
My wings are loud.
It has started to run.
I fold my wings and speed up.
I dive into its back.

lines.zh: 六条腿一抱，抓进它的背。
lines.en: Six legs clamp into its back.
I knock it forward.
My wings sweep its head.
Sand has blinded it.
That one didn't land solid.
I hit the ground and bounce up.
I'm circling again.
There's a mark on its shoulder.
My wing stings.
I rise from behind a dune.
The wingbeat arrives before I do.
This whole stretch is sand.
I drop low and circle.
Sand swirls beneath my wings.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见这个沙漠。
lines.en: This is my first look at this desert.
I fly toward that shape.
Heat rises off me.
I steady my wings in the heat.
I begin hunting.

lines.zh: 热浪把我翅边的膜烤卷了。
lines.en: The heat curls the membrane of my wings.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，摔进沙里。
lines.en: I drop from the air into the sand.
Water pins me and my wings won't open.

lines.zh: 冲击把我打横着吹出去。
lines.en: The blast throws me sideways.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的翅，打了个洞。
lines.en: An arrow punches a hole through my wing.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的翅停了一瞬。
lines.en: That light stops my wings for an instant.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我飞得又低又慢。
lines.en: Too long without food, and I fly low and slow.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我缩成一团落下。
lines.en: At the flash I curl and drop.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有了，我一直在掉。
lines.en: There's nothing below and I keep falling.
